headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang returns as CEO and markets surge, while India's Sensex has its worst day in four months and Ukraine's strike on a Russian ship in Libya widens the war.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu BJP chief arrested as Thirupparankundram hill lamp row peaks on festival day
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu's BJP chief was arrested at Thirupparankundram near Madurai on Karthigai Deepam day, with tight security in place. A court allowed the lamp to be lit on the hillock just once, and a review petition is still pending.
stories.why_it_matters: A religious dispute backed by court orders is turning into a major law-and-order and political flashpoint in the south.

stories.title: Nine killed in three road accidents in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Five pilgrims returning from the Srimukhalingam temple died when their SUV hit a parked lorry near Bhogapuram. Two Ayyappa devotees and others died in separate accidents.
stories.why_it_matters: Highway crashes involving parked lorries keep killing travellers on the NH-16 route in coastal Andhra.

stories.title: Supreme Court strikes down Uttar Pradesh pension laws that denied credit for early temporary service
stories.summary: The court struck down UP's 2021 and 2025 pension laws. Eligible employees can now count earlier daily-wage, temporary and work-charged service towards qualifying for a pension.
stories.why_it_matters: It could secure pensions for many retired government workers who started in temporary jobs.

stories.title: Ukraine sinks Russian warship at a port in Libya
stories.summary: Ukraine struck and sank a Russian battleship at a port in Libya, far from the front lines. Russia also hit the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, killing two people.
stories.why_it_matters: The war is spreading to new regions, which raises the risk of wider conflict.

stories.title: Reports say Russia may put a nuclear weapon in orbit; NATO vows to defend
stories.summary: German media reported Russia may launch a satellite carrying a nuclear warhead within weeks. The head of NATO, the Western military alliance, said it will defend against space threats.
stories.why_it_matters: A nuclear blast in space could knock out thousands of satellites that phones, GPS and banking rely on.

stories.title: UN climate talks COP31 end with no deal
stories.summary: The climate summit in Turkey closed without an agreement for the first time since 2009. Countries split over fossil fuels and climate funding.
stories.why_it_matters: It weakens global action on climate, which hits countries like India hard through heat and floods.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh on 16 December
stories.summary: Bangladesh's ousted former prime minister set a return date for the first time. Bangladesh's government says she can only come back through extradition.
stories.why_it_matters: It could stir up tension in India's neighbour, where she has lived in exile.

stories.title: Wall Street and Asia jump as Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia shares jumped 31% after Huang was reinstated as CEO, lifting the US Nasdaq 100 by 6.5% and Asian markets by over 4%. Nvidia added more than $1 trillion in value.
stories.why_it_matters: One company's leadership swing moved global markets, and the AI-driven rally affects funds that hold such shares.

stories.title: Sensex has its worst day in over four months before a holiday
stories.summary: 22 of the 30 Sensex stocks fell, and the Nifty dropped below 25,350, with banks and metals leading losses. Indian markets were closed on Tuesday.
stories.why_it_matters: A sharp one-day drop after a strong November, though SIP investors are best served by staying the course.

stories.title: Indian markets gain nearly 11% in November on record foreign inflows
stories.summary: The Sensex rose nearly 11% in November, adding about Rs 34.6 lakh crore for investors. Foreign investors put in over Rs 1 lakh crore, helped by lower oil prices and good company results.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a strong month for index-fund investors, though a revival of AI shares abroad could pull foreign money away.

stories.title: RBI proposes a 'stop switch' to block digital payment fraud
stories.summary: RBI, India's central bank, proposed safeguards including an account-wide 'Stop' option against electronic payment fraud.
stories.why_it_matters: It could give ordinary UPI and bank users a quick way to freeze their account when scammed.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: allotment due 25 November, listing 27 November
stories.summary: The Rs 8,981 crore IPO, where the company first sells shares to the public, was subscribed 1.52 times. Allotment is expected on 25 November and listing on 27 November.
stories.why_it_matters: Applicants can check allotment status online through KFin Technologies, NSE or BSE.

stories.title: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as CEO after scandal; Trump says he pushed for it
stories.summary: Huang resigned on November 12 after reports of affairs, including with a businesswoman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The board reinstated him after President Trump said he spoke to the board, and Huang is due to testify before the US Senate next week.
stories.why_it_matters: Leadership of the world's key AI chip maker is now tied up with politics and legal risks.

stories.title: Amazon buys Decart's AI optimisation technology in a reported $7.5 billion deal
stories.summary: Amazon is acquiring the technology and research team of Decart, which makes AI run more efficiently on chips. It is preparing to sell its own Trainium AI chips.
stories.why_it_matters: Big tech is buying AI talent rather than building it, which shapes where AI jobs go.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship so AI agents can review and approve code changes
stories.summary: Claude Ship lets AI review, fix and approve code changes based on rules set by a team.
stories.why_it_matters: It shifts routine code review work from engineers to AI agents.

stories.title: Google Cloud confirms about 30 job cuts in India
stories.summary: Google Cloud said it cut about 30 roles in India last week and denied rumours of wider layoffs.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a small cut, but a sign of job nervousness in tech.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya hits 181 in a T20 match, second-highest ever
stories.summary: Delhi captain Priyansh Arya smashed 181 with 19 sixes against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy.
stories.why_it_matters: A record-level innings that will get him noticed by IPL teams.

stories.title: New Zealand change Test squad before second Test against India on 27 November
stories.summary: Fisher replaces injured Tickner for the second Test in Christchurch.
stories.why_it_matters: It sets up the next match of the series.
